RIDER: Thanks for flagging this — we've sent your case to a RydeHELP human reviewer. Because it's a safety concern, we don't decide these automatically.

The reviewer will ask for your account of what was said, in your own words, along with when it happened. They'll also look at the driver's response, whether any contact details were exchanged, and any in-app or audio record from your trip.

No fare ruling has been made, so nothing is charged or refunded at this stage. Your account is in good standing and this report doesn't affect it.

A separate notice tells you when to expect the reviewer to be in touch.

DRIVER: We're writing about a rider report from one of your trips. Because it involves a safety concern, we've sent it to a RydeHELP human reviewer rather than deciding it automatically.

The reviewer will look at the rider's account of the trip, your response, whether any contact details were exchanged, and any in-app or audio record from that ride.

No decision has been made, and the fare for the trip is not being adjusted at this stage. Your account stays active while this is reviewed.

A separate notice tells you when to expect the reviewer to be in touch.
